_comment: Mid-sized fitness creator (~80K followers across TT+IG). Goal: grow long-form arm. 4 moves + 1 anti-pattern.

input.goalsFromSoul: Grow YouTube long-form arm to 50K subs in next 6 months; land 4 brand deals this quarter.

moves.move: Resume long-form YouTube — your last 4 long videos hit 2.1× baseline; stopping the format is the gap between you and your goal.
moves.evidence: byFormat: long=2.1x avg over n=4 (yt_long_55, yt_long_58, yt_long_61). Goals: grow YT long-form to 50K subs.
moves.expectedOutcome: Likely lift: similar to your last 4 long posts (~2× baseline). One per week for 4 weeks should move the needle on the 50K-sub goal.

moves.move: Post one Sunday this week — your Sunday posts average 2.0× baseline and you've shipped only 3 in the recent window.
moves.evidence: byDayOfWeek: sun=2.0x avg over n=3 (tt_938, ig_reel_402, yt_long_61).
moves.expectedOutcome: Likely lift: ~2× baseline based on prior Sunday performance.

moves.move: Lean into the POV hook — 3.1× baseline across 3 posts. Try one POV per week for 4 weeks to confirm the pattern at higher n.
moves.evidence: byHookPattern: POV=3.1x avg over n=3 (ig_reel_402, ig_reel_409, tt_945).
moves.expectedOutcome: Likely lift: similar to the 3 prior POV posts. Note: small sample — confirm with more reps before treating as a guaranteed win.

moves.move: Add a carousel slot to your IG cadence — your 6 carousels averaged 1.6× baseline (vs Reels at 1.0×). Saves are the IG ranking signal.
moves.evidence: byFormat: carousel=1.6x avg over n=6 (ig_car_88, ig_car_91).
moves.expectedOutcome: Likely lift: similar to your last 6 carousels (~1.6× baseline). Schedule one carousel per week.

antiPatterns: Stop the 'talking-head intro' open — 6 posts with that hook averaged 0.3× baseline (tt_910, tt_915, ig_reel_390). Your audience tunes out before the payoff.
